newsitem.title: USA: Envoy to buy Aetna unit.
newsitem.headline: Envoy to buy Aetna unit.

text.p: Envoy Corp. said Monday it agreed to pay Aetna U.S. Healthcare about $36.4 million to acquire its Healthcare Data Interchange Corp. subsidiary.
As part of the deal, the companies have a long-term agreement under which Aetna U.S. Healthcare will use Envoy for all electronic health care transactions.
Envoy said it expects the deal to close in August.

Healthcare Data was created by Aetna U.S. Healthcare in 1992 to develop electronic systems for claims and member referral processing. It manages all electronic claims, referrals, and eligibility verification processing between Aetna U.S. Healthcare and its participating network physicians, dentists and hospitals.
Envoy, based in Nashville, Tenn., provides electronic data services to participants in the health care industry.
Aetna U.S. Healthcare is a unit of Aetna Inc.
Envoy's stock edged up 37.5 cents to $33.125 on Nasdaq at mid-morning. Aetna fell $1.625 to $111 on the New York Stock Exchange.
